instruction: Help me plan a weekend trip to Tokyo.
output: You can arrange a two-day Tokyo itinerary for your weekend trip. On the first day, you can visit Asakusa Temple, Tokyo Skytree, and Ueno Park. In the evening, you can explore Shinjuku for food and nightlife. On the second day, you can visit Shibuya, Meiji Shrine, and Omotesando for shopping. It is recommended to check transportation routes in advance and adjust your plan based on the weather.
